title.en: Take from a heap: sift down

hints.tr: `n = len(heap)` ve `while True:` içinde `smallest = i`; her `child` için `child < n and heap[child] < heap[smallest]` ise `smallest = child`.
hints.en: `n = len(heap)` and inside `while True:`, `smallest = i`; for each `child`, if `child < n and heap[child] < heap[smallest]`, `smallest = child`.

hints.tr: `smallest == i` ise `return top`; değilse yer değiştir ve `i = smallest`.
hints.en: If `smallest == i`, `return top`; otherwise swap and `i = smallest`.

hint.en: Do not use `sorted`; use a heap.
Do not use `heapq.heappop`; write the sift down yourself.
Do not use `min`; compare the children.
